 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMIT SHARMA  ORDER % 23.03.2023 CRL.M.A. 7669/2023 Exemption 1. Exemption allowed, subject to just exceptions.
2. The application is disposed of accordingly.

3. The present appeal under Section 374(2) read with Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. is directed against the judgment of conviction and order on sentence dated 16.09.2022 and 28.01.2023, respectively passed by learned ASJ-04 (North), Saket Courts, New Delhi in SC No. 58067/2016, in case FIR No.
384/2010 under Section 392/397/411/418/34 of the IPC, registered at P.S. Vijay Vihar.

4. The appellant has been convicted for offence under Section 397 of the IPC and sentenced to undergo 7 years of rigorous imprisonment alongwith fine of Rs. 20,000/- and in default simple imprisonment for 6 months.

The appellant has been convicted for offence under Section 392 of the IPC and sentenced to undergo 5 yeras of rigourous imprisonment alongwith fine of Rs. 15,000/- and in default, simple imprisonment for 4 months.
The appellant has been convicted for offence under Section 411 of the IPC and sentenced to undergo simple imprisonment for 1 year alongwith fine of Rs. 5,000/-.
The appellant has been convicted for offence under Section 419 of the IPC and sentenced to undergo 1 year of simple imprisonment alongwith fine of Rs. 5,000/-.

5. Admit.
